integrity: The asserted equivalence has a complete modular/interval proof and a self-contained, finite integer-arithmetic verifier. Finite tests are corroborative, not exhaustive over all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only sets consisting entirely of odd divisors of 2^k p^e, with odd prime p, k>=1 and e>=2. Allows other even-divisor omission sets, does not assert all-omission uniqueness, and does not assert infinitely many Mersenne primes. The 2016 Adajar thesis was not available in full for comparison. No independent mathematical validation performed.
title: Odd-divisor omission rigidity for binary–prime-power near-perfect numbers
